report.explanation: Gateway metrics show low error rate (0.0012), p95 73ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, and INFO/200 logs, contradicting the alert. Only one ERROR trace span (gateway call order, 1915ms) exists, with no downstream telemetry. Current evidence cannot establish a bounded root cause; hand off for downstream service telemetry.
